name: Golden Rule
overview: The Golden Rule, as taught in Scripture, calls believers to treat others with the same love and respect they desire for themselves, encapsulating the heart of God's law and the prophets (Matthew 7:12). This principle is rooted in the command to love one's neighbor as oneself, a commandment emphasized both in the Old Testament (Leviticus 19:18; Mark 12:31) and affirmed by Christ. Additionally, Scripture warns against judgmental attitudes (Matthew 7:1), promoting grace and mercy in interpersonal relationships. The care for others extends even to rest and provision, as seen in the Sabbath instructions that include servants and animals (Deuteronomy 5:14-15), reflecting God's compassionate design for community life.
